events.title: Digital Skills: One-On-One Tech Help for Seniors
Digital Skills: One-On-One Tech Help for Seniors

cases.refreshed: Do you have questions or need assistance with technology? At the Almaden Branch, you can make a 30-minute appointment for assistance with: Learning to use Libby from OverDrive to read ebooks and listen to e-audiobooks; Finding e-books from Enki; Accessing the New York Times and/or the San Jose Mercury News online; Accessing and searching Consumer Reports; Learning a new language with Mango; Connecting to Wi-Fi/hotspots; Using Discover & Go to reserve free or reduced tickets to local museums and attractions; Navigating the SJPL website; Checking out a 7-day pass to access Great Courses from Libby; Using the library's pay-to-print system; Walking you through a Digital Skills Building Pathways lesson; And much more! By appointment only. One appointment per week per person. For questions, please call (408) 808-3040 or send an email to ab.sjpl@sjlibrary.org.
cases.reviewed: The Almaden Branch offers 30-minute tech help appointments. Get help using Libby from OverDrive to read ebooks and listen to audiobooks, finding ebooks from Enki, reading the New York Times and the San Jose Mercury News online, or accessing and searching Consumer Reports. You can also get help learning a language with Mango, connecting to Wi-Fi or a hotspot, or using Discover & Go to reserve free or reduced-price tickets to local museums and attractions. Other topics include navigating the SJPL website, checking out a 7-day pass to Great Courses through Libby, using the library's pay-to-print system, and working through a Digital Skills Building Pathways lesson. By appointment only. One appointment per week per person. For questions, please call (408) 808-3040 or send an email to ab.sjpl@sjlibrary.org.

cases.refreshed: Join us on Tuesday mornings for Baby Bouncers Lapsit (for non-walking babies) up to 12 months old. This is a program for babies and caregivers with an early literacy focus on traditional nursery rhymes, lap bounces, body rhymes, songs, and very short and simple picture books. Caregivers are welcome to bring a blanket for their babies to lie on. The Baby Bouncers Lapsit program is a short 15- to 20-minute program. Caregivers are welcome to attend our Stay and Play session after the program. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.

events.title: The Plot Thickens Mystery Book Discussion – Hercule Poirot's Christmas

cases.refreshed: The Plot Thickens Mystery Book Discussion: Hercule Poirot's Christmas by Agatha Christie (1938). A family reunion at Christmas time should suggest family warmth and seasonal merriment. When the tyrannical millionaire Simeon Lee commands his four sons to join him at his country estate for Christmas, Hercule Poirot finds himself trying to solve the mystery of his host's murder, instead. After Lee alienates each of his sons with barbed insults and announces he's planning to change his will, all four of them have a motive to want their father dead. The Plot Thickens Mystery Book Discussion meets on the first Wednesday of even months at 11 am in Room 201B. All adults who love to read and discuss mysteries are welcome. All meetings are sponsored by The Friends of the Cupertino Library. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
